index.pillars_desc: Four simple ways SpringWave helps you make the most of your student life.

index.pillar2_desc: Discover activities, competitions, workshops, and events that match your interests.

index.pillars_main_title: A Standardized Extracurricular Platform for Students & Clubs
index.pillars_main_desc: Zero empty slogans. SpringWave solves the three most practical needs of modern university life.
index.pillar1_text: No more chasing updates across dozens of Facebook pages and chat groups. All workshops, hackathons, seminars, and volunteer initiatives are curated with transparent deadlines and verified details.
index.pillar2_text: An inter-campus ecosystem. Connect with like-minded peers to form hackathon & research teams, or discover and join student clubs aligned with your career ambition.
index.pillar3_text: A professional experience for both attendees and organizers: Personalized QR passes, 1-second gate check-ins, real-time participant rosters, and instant tamper-proof digital certificates.
index.host_callout_title: Are you a Student Club Leader or Event Organizer?
index.host_callout_desc: Eliminate 90% of manual paper check-ins and spreadsheet chaos. Publish events, scan QR tickets instantly, export attendance rosters, and issue verifiable digital certificates effortlessly.
index.faq_desc: Quick answers to common questions about event participation and digital certificate issuance on SpringWave.
index.faq_q1_title: Does participating in SpringWave events count towards Student Training Points (ĐRL)?
index.faq_q1_ans: Yes. Official events hosted by verified student clubs and faculty partners on SpringWave provide verifiable attendance records and digital certificates with QR validation, helping students claim extracurricular credit according to university guidelines.
index.faq_q2_title: How do I receive and verify my digital certificate after attending?
index.faq_q2_ans: Once organizers scan your QR pass at the venue, your digital certificate is instantly issued to your Profile. You can view, download a high-res bilingual PDF, or share the public verification link directly to your resume and LinkedIn.
index.faq_q3_title: Do student clubs and teams have to pay to host events on SpringWave?
index.faq_q3_ans: It is 100% free. SpringWave empowers student organizations with free event publishing, QR ticketing, check-in scanning, and certificate distribution with zero platform fees.
index.faq_q4_title: Where can I find teammates to join competitions or hackathons together?
index.faq_q4_ans: Head over to the 'Community' tab in the navigation bar. You can publish teammate requests for upcoming hackathons, discuss university-specific topics, and get insights from past attendees.
index.hero_desc: SpringWave uses AI to help students find activities, communities, competitions, and opportunities that align with their goals, interests, and personal growth journey.
index.how_heading: Three Steps to Your Growth Journey
index.how_desc: SpringWave analyzes your profile and helps map a personalized pathway toward your goals.
index.step1_desc: Answer a few questions about your interests, skills, and goals to build your starting profile.
index.step2_desc: Receive tailored opportunities ranked by fit — from workshops to community activities.

index.bento_smart_connect_desc: Cross-uni study buddies matched dynamically by skill set.
index.faq_desc: Find answers to the most common questions about the SpringWave platform and its AI engine.
index.faq_q1: How does the SpringWave AI matchmaker work?
index.faq_a1: SpringWave utilizes our custom RAG/LLM engine to evaluate your survey responses across four criteria: Communication, Technical, Creativity, and Social Impact. It compares your profile against our extracurricular catalog to recommend activities that align with your career goals and skill gap recommendations.
index.faq_q2: What is the gamification contribution system?
index.faq_a2: Every time you engage with the community — starting a thread in the forum, replying to a discussion, or participating in university clubs — you earn Experience Points (XP). Unlocking certain XP thresholds increases your level and unlocks 16 uniquely-colored badges showcased on your profile.
index.faq_q3: Can I register as an organizer (Host) on the platform?
index.faq_a3: Yes, absolutely! By clicking "Register Host" in the navbar, you can submit an organizer request. Once approved by the administrator, you'll gain access to the Organization Dashboard to create activities, map venues, register attendees, and scan attendance QR codes.
index.faq_q4: Is student verification required to participate in events?
index.faq_a4: Some official partner workshops and tournaments require verified student status to ensure certificate integrity. You can easily upload a student ID image in your settings, and the administrative dashboard will verify it within 24 hours.

about.title: About Us — SpringWave
about.hero_title: Empowering student life through unified discovery.
about.hero_desc: SpringWave is a modern digital platform designed to bridge academic, extracurricular, and community opportunities across universities into one seamless experience.
about.story_quote: “We missed workshops and competitions not because we lacked passion, but because information was scattered across dozens of random fanpages and chat groups.”
about.story_p1: As first-year university students in Da Nang, we experienced firsthand how difficult it was to navigate extracurricular life. Crucial announcements, workshop sign-ups, and student club recruitments were constantly buried under social media algorithms.
about.story_p2: We founded RAH Studio with a clear purpose: create a single, clean, student-centric home where every event, discussion, and roadmap is structured, searchable, and verified.
about.pillars_subtitle: An interconnected suite of tools designed to guide you through your university journey.
about.pillar_1_desc: Search, filter, and register for workshops, hackathons, seminars, and club recruitments across universities in one place.
about.pillar_2_desc: Engage in genuine academic and social discussions with students from different faculties and partner universities.
about.pillar_3_desc: Discover personalized event recommendations and skill paths based on your major, strengths, and quiz results.
about.pillar_4_desc: Authentic student verification and activity certificates to build your verifiable extracurricular portfolio.
about.team_title: Meet RAH Gang - Really Awesome Humans
about.team_subtitle: Passionate first-year software engineering students dedicated to crafting high-quality, practical technology for the student community.
about.member_1_bio: Leads project architecture, core frontend design, and AI integration with a focus on fluid user experiences.
about.member_2_bio: Architects backend REST APIs, authentication security, database modeling, and community discussion engines.
about.member_3_bio: Builds robust server routes, administrative control dashboards, and deployment automation pipelines.
about.member_4_bio: Crafts typography, design tokens, responsive layouts, and interactive design systems across the entire platform.
about.value_1_desc: No bloated feeds or unnecessary clutter. We build focused interfaces that respect your time and attention.
about.value_2_desc: Verified student identities and curated event organizers ensure high-quality, reliable opportunities.
about.value_3_desc: Bridging barriers between clubs and universities to foster a collaborative student ecosystem.
about.step_1_desc: Identified information fragmentation across Da Nang universities and conceptualized SpringWave.
about.step_2_desc: Interviewed club leaders, crafted UI design systems in Figma, and mapped user flows.
about.step_3_desc: Developed backend APIs, MongoDB schemas, interactive components, and Gemini AI matching.
about.step_4_desc: Optimized performance, implemented i18n localization, and finalized community features.
about.step_5_desc: Expanding partner universities and onboarding student clubs across the region.
about.journey: SpringWave is not just a school project — it is the beginning of a journey to create technology solutions that bring real value to the Vietnamese student community.
about.quote_text: “SpringWave is not just a school project — it is our commitment to building technology that brings lasting value to student life.”
about.cta_desc: Join hundreds of students discovering activities, building skills, and growing together on SpringWave.
about.story_card_1_desc: Every workshop & hackathon structured in one unified database.

policy.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service — SpringWave
policy.hero_desc: SpringWave is dedicated to protecting student and organizer data, upholding ethical AI standards, and honoring all Google API Services User Data Policies.
policy.compliance_banner_title: Google API Limited Use Compliance Notice
policy.compliance_banner_desc: SpringWave's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
policy.sec1_p1: SpringWave ("we", "our", or "the Platform") is a digital platform built by and for students across universities. Our mission is to democratize discovery of extracurricular activities, workshops, competitions, skill roadmaps, and community interactions.
policy.sec1_p2: We believe privacy is a fundamental right. This Policy explains how we collect, handle, protect, and delete your personal information, including information accessed when you choose to use Single Sign-On (SSO) such as Sign in with Google.
policy.sec2_desc: We only collect information strictly necessary to provide and enhance our educational services.
policy.google_scope_desc: When you sign in using "Sign in with Google", we request access to basic profile scopes (openid, email, profile). This grants us access to:
policy.google_data_2: Primary email address (used for authentication and notifications)
policy.google_data_3: Full Name (used for your student profile and certificate issuance)
policy.google_data_4: Profile avatar photo URL (displayed in navigation and community discussions)
policy.user_data_title: B. Information Provided Directly By You
policy.user_data_desc: Depending on your participation level, you may optionally provide university/campus, student ID card photo (for student verification badge), academic faculty/major, class, date of birth, and phone number.
policy.use_1_desc: Verifying your identity, preventing fraud, generating secure sessions, and verifying requests with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.
policy.use_2_desc: Issuing dynamic check-in QR codes, tracking activity attendance, and reserving seats in workshops.
policy.use_3_desc: Printing and verifying digital completion certificates with cryptographic tracking and organizer signatures.
policy.use_4_desc: Recommending relevant student clubs, hackathons, and growth roadmaps based on your stated interests and quiz results.
policy.sec4_title: 4. Google API Services User Data Policy & Limited Use
policy.sec4_p1: SpringWave strictly complies with Google's API Services User Data Policy. In particular:
policy.sec4_rule1_desc: We NEVER sell, rent, lease, trade, or monetize Google user data under any circumstances.
policy.sec4_rule2_desc: Google user data is NEVER used or transferred for serving advertisements, retargeting campaigns, or broker profiling.
policy.sec4_rule3_title: No AI Model Training on Private Data
policy.sec4_rule3_desc: We do NOT use Google user data to train or fine-tune generalized machine learning foundation models.
policy.sec4_rule4_desc: No human employees or contractors inspect your private Google account data, unless you grant explicit affirmative permission for resolving a technical support incident, or if legally compelled by law.
policy.sec5_p1: We employ enterprise-grade security protocols. All network traffic is encrypted via HTTPS / TLS 1.3.
policy.sec5_p2: Mutating requests are signed with client-side Web Crypto HMAC-SHA256 signatures (X-Timestamp, X-Nonce, and X-Signature) ensuring zero replay attacks and tampering protection.
policy.sec6_p1: We do not sell your personal data. We only utilize trusted infrastructure providers strictly necessary to deliver the service:
policy.third_party_2: Cloudflare (DDoS mitigation, CDN, Turnstile bot protection)
policy.third_party_3: Secure cloud database infrastructure with encrypted backups
policy.sec7_desc: You retain absolute ownership and control over your personal data at all times.
policy.del_step1_desc: Visit your SpringWave Profile page, click "Account Settings", and select "Delete Account". All your personal data and linked tokens will be permanently purged.
policy.del_step2_desc: Send an email to springwave15062026@gmail.com with the subject "Data Deletion Request" from your registered email address. We will verify and process your deletion within 30 days.
policy.del_step3_title: Option 3: Revoke Access in Google Settings
policy.del_step3_desc: You can immediately revoke SpringWave's permissions at any time via your Google Account Security Dashboard (myaccount.google.com/permissions).
policy.sec8_desc: We use LocalStorage solely for essential authentication tokens (JWT, signing key) and UI preferences (language, theme). We do not use third-party tracking cookies.
policy.sec9_desc: SpringWave is designed for higher-education students. We do not intentionally collect information from individuals under 16 years of age. Student ID verification photos are encrypted, stored in restricted buckets, and reviewed only by authorized administrators.
policy.tos_1_desc: Users agree to maintain civil, constructive interactions in community forums and avoid posting spam, malicious links, or harassment.
policy.tos_2_desc: Organizers must provide accurate event descriptions, respect attendee privacy, and ensure safety during scheduled activities.
policy.tos_3_desc: Certificates issued on SpringWave are legally tracked. Any forging, falsifying, or tampering with certificates will result in permanent account termination.
policy.contact_desc: If you have questions about this policy, Google data handling, or wish to exercise your privacy rights, our team is here to assist:
policy.contact_response: Commitment: We respond to all formal privacy requests within 48 business hours.
